title: Anna and Tom
text:
Anna is seventeen years old. She goes to a school in Krakow. She likes biology and chemistry. Next year she wants to study medicine at university.

Her brother Tom works in an office. He is an accountant. He got his job after he finished college. Anna thinks she will be a doctor one day.

questions.text: What can we guess about Anna's future career?
options: She probably wants to work in medicine.
She wants to become an accountant like Tom.
She does not like science at school.
She plans to leave school this year.

questions.text: What can we guess about Tom from the passage?
options: He is probably an adult with a full-time job.
He still goes to school every day.
He does not like his job.
He works as a doctor in a hospital.

vocabulary.definition: a room or building where people work at desks
a person whose job is to manage money and financial records
a place where people study after finishing school
the study of illness and how to treat it

paragraph_translations: Anna ma siedemnaście lat. Chodzi do szkoły w Krakowie. Lubi biologię i chemię. W przyszłym roku chce studiować medycynę na uniwersytecie.
Jej brat Tom pracuje w biurze. Jest księgowym. Dostał pracę, kiedy skończył studia. Anna myśli, że pewnego dnia zostanie lekarką.
